                            id="routing-target"
                            name="targetId"
                            required
                            className={selectClass}
                            disabled={
                              routingTargetType === 'product'
                                ? productsQuery.isLoading || Boolean(productsQuery.error)
                                : categoriesQuery.isLoading || Boolean(categoriesQuery.error)
                            }
                          >
                            <option value="">
                              {(
                                routingTargetType === 'product'
                                  ? productsQuery.isLoading
                                  : categoriesQuery.isLoading
                              )
                                ? 'Loading catalog…'
                                : (
                                      routingTargetType === 'product'
                                        ? productsQuery.error
                                        : categoriesQuery.error
                                    )
                                  ? 'Catalog unavailable for your access'
                                  : `Choose a ${routingTargetType}`}
                            </option>
                            {(routingTargetType === 'product'
                              ? (productsQuery.data ?? []).map((item) => ({
                                  id: item.id,
                                  label: item.name,
                                }))
                              : (categoriesQuery.data ?? []).map((item) => ({
                                  id: item.id,
                                  label: item.name,
                                }))
                            )
                              .filter((item) =>
                                item.label
                                  .toLowerCase()
                                  .includes(routingTargetSearch.trim().toLowerCase())
                              )
                              .map((item) => (
                                <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>
                                  {item.label}
                                </option>
                              ))}
                          </select>

                          onChange={(event) => {
                            const selectedBill = Number(event.target.value);
                            setAssignments((current) => {
                              const next = { ...current, [item.id]: selectedBill };
                              const billNumbers = [...new Set(Object.values(next))].sort(
